codes.deleg: the provision delegates the period to rules or to the Board
codes.mismatch: the provision carries periods and none of them is this one
codes.missing: the cited provision was not found in the held text
codes.nocite: this rule cites no numbered provision
codes.noctx: the provision was located but no readable span came back
codes.noperiod: this rule states no period, so there is nothing to compare
codes.nostate: the rule states a period and the provision states none
codes.ok: the period this rule states appears in the provision it cites
codes.sched: a Schedule entry: the period is in the Schedule item, not in the regulation it cites
codes.stale: not in the 01.04.2021 Act text — a wrong citation, or newer than the text held here

limit: A period is compared against the WHOLE cited provision, not against the sub-clause the rule names. An agreement means the number appears in the provision, not that it appears in the clause cited.
